exposure: daily dosage of 500 mg of Channa striatus extract
outcome: anteroposterior (AP) measurements of the uterus in the longitudinal and oblique transverse planes
pulsatility index (PI) of the uterine and superficial skin wound arteries
resistive index (RI) of the uterine and superficial skin wound arteries
cohort: 66 women after Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS)
finding: Daily intake of Channa striatus extract resulted in significant differences in AP measurements of the uterus, indicating improved uterine involution, compared to placebo in women post LSCS.
